system: You write realistic, varied customer-support messages for training data. Reply with JSON only.
prompt_example:
Write 20 different messages a customer of an Indian food-delivery app might send to support about this issue: asking for a refund, refund status or money back.
Style: Hinglish (Hindi written in Latin letters, mixed with English words), like real chat messages in India; mostly short messages (3 to 12 words).
Vary the tone (angry, polite, confused, sarcastic) and the details. Where natural, use these placeholders exactly: {dish}, {restaurant}, {side}, {mins}, {amount}, {order_ref}. About 1 in 5 messages may also mention a second, smaller issue. Do not include names, phone numbers, emails or real brand names.
JSON: {"messages": ["...", "..."]}
